#534's preservation is locally complete at
`d831db9b83db4bb3292e4c41c838e4368b90cf92` on NEW
`issue-515-preserve-point-consistency-20260918`, base `5080d852`.
Three public auxiliary contracts were preserved: point self-consistency
defect on uniform samples, its line-point transport, and restoration using
the exact discarded mass. The other three old names map to existing generic,
projection and resampling results; no duplicate aliases were added.

MAIN verified the six committed files, seven artifact hashes and clean head.
The original150-line audit (8821 bytes) and17 event lines are byte-identical
in qualified historical archives. The author completed focused Lean/targeted
build/root-import checks, three fresh standard-only axiom probes, blueprint
render/sync/citations/checkdecls and normal hooks. Initial ignored-index and
whitespace diagnostics and their resolutions are retained in the receipt.
No full CI, publication or independent review has occurred. The source
lem:qld-xz-lines remains notready, and the issue515 sum/product error
qualification remains explicit. Original #534 and issue #515 stay open.

by the strict patch mismatch, not an automatic carry or fifth full proof review.
Admission is archived in `native-reviews/pr465-287ddbc2-01a0b1bc/`.

The cycle snapshot completed. The previous cycle was progress (green #465
gates, #584 finding routed, preservation admitted); this cycle completes the
